identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase III Clinical Trial of DP-R206 and Bonvia In Postmenopausal Women With Osteoporosis
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Active-controlled, Phase III Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of DP-R206 and Bonviva for the Improvement of Vitamin D in Postmenopausal Women With Osteoporosis

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A multicenter, randomized, double-blind, active-controlled, phase III clinical trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Dp-R206 and Bonviva for 16 weeks once a month on the improvement of vitamin D in postmenopausal women with osteoporosis.

interventions.name: Test group
interventions.description: Once a month, administration of DP-R206 \& placebo for 16 weeks

interventions.name: Reference group
interventions.description: Once a month, administration of Bonviva \& placebo for 16 weeks

primaryOutcomes.measure: A ratio of subject whose 25 OHD concentration is less than 15ng/mL
primaryOutcomes.description: A ratio of subject whose 25 OHD concentration is less than 15ng/mL after 16weeks

secondaryOutcomes.measure: A ratio of subject whose 25 OHD concentration is less than 9ng/mL
secondaryOutcomes.description: A ratio of subject whose 25 OHD concentration is less than 9ng/mL after 16weeks

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Safety evaluation (AE, Lab test, Vital sign etc)

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female more than 40 years old in postmenopausal

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subject who has a history of malignant cancer

locations.facility: The Catholic University of Korea Seoul St. Mary's Hospital
